title: COP31: What next after UN climate talks collapse
summary:
UN member states fail to agree on how to fast-track action to reverse global warming in blow to climate agenda.
United Nations climate talks have ended in collapse after countries deadlocked over the phasing out of planet-warming fossil fuels, aiding energy transition for developing countries and the response to natural disasters.
On the contrary, the text made no mention of fossil fuels while promoting carbon capture.
The collapse of the climate talks in Turkiye has renewed questions about reform of its consensus-based process, centred around the principle that all countries must agree to the reforms.
However, calls for reform are multiplying and a second tier of COPs – the Global Climate Action Agenda – is rising in prominence.

title: Thanksgiving Travel Will Be a Stormy Mess
summary:
Expect travel headaches from coast to coast this week.
Several rounds of disruptive weather sweep are likely to cause delays at airports and make for challenging driving conditions just in time for the Thanksgiving long weekend.
Potent systems rolling into the West Coast will bring disruptions from Seattle to San Francisco, where high tides could swamp airport runways.
The stormy setup arrives at the peak travel time of the year in the US.
And with the extreme weather this week is set to sweep across some of the country’s biggest travel hubs, it could upend the best-laid travel plans.
